newsitem.title: POLAND: Foreign investor to buy Polish paintmaker.
newsitem.headline: Foreign investor to buy Polish paintmaker.

text.p: A foreign investor will soon sign a letter of intent with Polish paintmaker Polifarb Kalisz SA on taking a 60-percent-stake in the company, Polifarb's president said on Thursday.
"In the next few days, possibly by the end of the week, a letter of intent with a foreign investor, who intends to take 60 percent of our shares will be signed," Stanislaw Popeda told Reuters.
He said the investor would buy the company's new shares. The investor's name would be disclosed only after the letter of intent had been signed, he added.

Polifarb Kalisz's shareholders are National Investment (NFI) No. 6, called Magna Polonia, which has 33 percent of shares, other 14 NFIs with 27 percent of shares, the treasury with a 25 percent stake and employees, who have 15 percent.
The firm, based in central city of Kalisz, had a net loss of five million zlotys on 60-million-zloty-sales last year.
